announcements.headline: Director Dealing

announcements.headline: Full Year Results for the Year Ended 30 April 2026
announcements.insight: As a closed-end investment trust with a concentrated portfolio in UK small-cap equities, the full-year results are critical for assessing net asset value (NAV) performance and dividend sustainability against rising interest rate pressures. The outcome will likely trigger immediate re-rating of the share premium/discount relative to peers like Baillie Gifford or City of London.
